user.title: ViCare Extras
user.description: Adds the Viessmann API features the core ViCare integration does not expose. Uses the existing ViCare login and its already fetched data - no extra API calls.

data_description.calorific_value: From your gas bill (Brennwert). Enables gas energy sensors in kWh.

abort.no_vicare: Set up the core ViCare integration first.

core_internals_changed.title: ViCare Extras cannot read the ViCare integration
core_internals_changed.description: The internal structure of the core ViCare integration changed (probably after a Home Assistant update), so ViCare Extras cannot read its data any more. The core integration itself is unaffected. Please update ViCare Extras. Error: {error}

set_holiday.name: Schedule holiday program
set_holiday.description: Schedules the boiler's holiday (or holiday at home) program for a date range.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: ViCare device (optional, defaults to the one that supports it).

change_holiday_end.name: Change holiday end
change_holiday_end.description: Moves the end date of a scheduled holiday program.

cancel_holiday.name: Cancel holiday program
cancel_holiday.description: Cancels a scheduled or running holiday program.

execute_command.name: Execute ViCare command
execute_command.description: Runs any command the ViCare API offers for a feature. Parameters are validated against the API's own constraints before sending.

set_schedule_day.name: Set schedule day(s)
set_schedule_day.description: Replaces the time slots of one or more days of a schedule; other days stay as they are. Mode defaults to the only allowed one (on) or normal.

entries.name: Time slots
entries.description: List of slots with start, end (HH:MM) and optional mode, 10-minute steps, max. 4 per day, no overlap.

copy_schedule_day.name: Copy schedule day
copy_schedule_day.description: Copies the time slots of one day to other days.

reset_schedule_day.name: Reset schedule day
reset_schedule_day.description: Resets one day to the boiler's factory default for that schedule.

reset_schedule.name: Reset whole schedule
reset_schedule.description: Resets the whole week of a schedule to the boiler's factory default. Cannot be undone - save it with get_schedule first.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns a schedule (all days, allowed modes and limits) as service response.

data_description.calorific_value: From your gas bill (Brennwert). Leave empty to disable the gas energy sensors.
